actions.title: Set up Postgres for agents in api
actions.why: In a clean container, api's tests fail because nothing starts Postgres: connection refused on port 5432.
actions.movesTheNeedle: Takes api to Level 1 for bug fixes, covering 56% of recent changes. Agents can run api's checks before they push, so fewer agent PRs fail CI the first time.
actions.watch: Share of agent PRs touching api that pass CI the first time. Now: 20% (1 of 5), Sep 27 to Oct 27, 2026.
actions.research: In the BootstrapAgent study, a reusable, verified setup cut later agents' token use by 25.9% and build time by 22.3%. Measured on the study's benchmark repositories. https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15815
actions.effortAndOwner: Small: setup scripts and environment config, no source changes. Repo maintainer.

actions.title: Make worker's tests catch wrong behavior
actions.why: The audit planted 5 faults in worker in a throwaway copy, and the tests caught 0.
actions.movesTheNeedle: Takes worker to Level 2 for bug fixes, covering 27% of recent changes. Changes in worker get a real pass-or-fail signal, so reviewers catch less by hand.
actions.watch: Share of agent PRs touching worker where a reviewer requested changes. Now: 2 of 3 (too few for a rate), Sep 27 to Oct 27, 2026.
actions.research: In DeployBench, 53.9% of failed runs passed generic checks and failed only task-specific ones. 51 research-artifact deployment tasks. https://deploybench.vercel.app/
actions.effortAndOwner: Medium: tests in worker only. Component owner.

actions.doneWhen: A new audit's fresh planted faults in worker are all caught.

actions.movesTheNeedle: Unlocks measured agent work in shared. The next report has real agent PR numbers for shared, which Level 3 is measured on.
actions.watch: Merged agent PRs touching shared. Now: 2 of 2 (too few for a rate), Sep 27 to Oct 27, 2026.

steps.title: Set up Postgres for agents in api
Ask the agent to fix it
steps.detail: Say "fix the primary blocker". It drafts install and start scripts and a `.cursor/environment.json` with `readiness draft-env`.

steps.title: The agent proves it
steps.detail: `readiness replay --component api` must pass every test before the fix is offered.

steps.title: Review and merge
steps.detail: Check that the start script only starts local services and names no production URLs.

steps.title: Point Cloud Agents at it
steps.detail: A team admin sets the Cloud Agent environment to read `.cursor/environment.json`; committing the file alone changes no environment.

steps.title: Re-audit
steps.detail: The next audit confirms Level 1 and can now plant faults in api.

steps.title: Make worker's tests catch wrong behavior
Decide the intended behavior
steps.detail: For the files named here, write down what correct behavior is, including edge cases.

steps.title: Write tests that pin it down
steps.detail: Assert results and edge cases, not just that code runs.

steps.title: Prove it with fresh faults
steps.detail: Run a new audit. It plants different faults than this one, so tests aimed at one audit's faults don't help.

steps.title: Review
steps.detail: `readiness diff` flags any deleted test or new skip marker, so nothing was weakened to pass.

steps.title: Give agents bug fixes in shared
Pick 3 to 5 real tasks
steps.detail: Well-scoped bug fixes that touch only shared.

steps.title: Hand them to agents
steps.detail: Agents run the verify skill before they push.

steps.title: Review as usual
steps.detail: The next audit counts these PRs by component.
